01 / Web game / 2026

CookiesClicker.

A browser-based incremental game built around one satisfying loop: click, earn cookies, grow the bakery, and unlock more ways to play.

A small game with a growing system.

Cookies Clicker turns a simple action into a progression game. Players collect cookies by clicking, then spend them on bakery upgrades that build momentum over time.

I made it as a web game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with an interface for upgrades, boosts, and live cookie stats. It was a chance to explore game feedback, economy balancing, and playful interaction in the browser.
